purpose: Bound the transfer claim and separate unchanged fitted-function transfer from target-trained method reuse.

proposed_changes.name: injury_only
proposed_changes.rationale: One25% injury increase already represented in development, tested on separate founders; not a novel or previously unseen parameter regime.

proposed_changes.name: writer_only
proposed_changes.rationale: One scalar change to the writer's tanh gain; preserve original exact-zero returning-edge fallback. Fleet-wide writer-outcome exposure has not yet been audited.

acquisition: Original acquisition and boundary-only selection contract; shifts begin after g14. New acquisition blocks with disjoint training/test IDs declared before outcomes; no packet-level train/test split within a founder block.
endpoint: 18 exact full rewrites g15..32 followed by a fresh terminal g33 read, all four original-rule-aligned late port means strictly>.25. Continue after earlier failure. Apply target injury throughout probes, continuation and terminal read; apply target beta to all inherited probe/future writer outputs. Acquisition B11 remains under the original acquisition contract.

primary_probe_family.name: successor32
primary_probe_family.features: Original B11 including signed/unsigned transfer, plus success fraction of32 one-rewrite successor evaluations.

route_A.claim: Transfer of an unchanged fitted function, with condition-specific new measurements.

route_B.claim: Reuse of the declared probing method after target-condition training; not unchanged-predictor transfer.
route_B.fit_policy: One fixed ridge-logistic fit per declared feature family per shift/noise cell, ridge0.01 and unconstrained slopes, with scaling estimated on that cell's training blocks only. No hyperparameter or feature search; a missing label class, optimizer failure or precision failure is reported, not patched after test outcomes.
route_B.additional_prevalence_controls: One training-only condition prevalence forecast per shifted condition; retain its label acquisition cost.
route_B.fairness: Identical target-training blocks, labels, feature access, loss and regularization for successor and corresponding ordinary comparators; same held-out test blocks. Exact fitter and weighting must be frozen and qualified before training.

primary_comparator: direct64 within each route: same64 native probe reads and B11 task information; same applicable source or target training knowledge.
additional_control_provenance: Archived quadratic/mean/expression direct64 controls were trained/calibrated on broader injury development data. Bind their exact bundles and report that extra knowledge and historical cost. Do not describe the primary old-model comparison as superiority over all ordinary alternatives.
prediction_barrier: Freeze protocol, cohort roles and namespaces before target training outcomes; freeze routeB fits after training; seal every routeA/routeB test probability and required comparator for the whole panel before any test continuation. Disjoint acquisition, probe, training-future and test-future streams.
proposed_primary_relation: For each of2 routes x2 shifts x2 noise regimes, block-balanced Brier(direct64)-Brier(successor32)>0. This is a candidate claim to test, not a claim supported by current results.
proposed_inference: Eight separate paired-acquisition-block contrasts, nominal block-t intervals plus conservative Bonferroni simultaneous95% intervals across the eight primaries (per-contrast two-sided confidence99.375%). Approximation and sample limitations must be reported. Secondary rivals and baseline-reference comparisons are descriptive unless separately registered.
proposed_decision: Per cell: nondegenerate simultaneous lower>0 supports the specified relative advantage; upper<=0 contradicts positive advantage; otherwise unresolved. Zero variance is unresolved. No pooled shift/noise rescue; routeB success cannot qualify routeA. No absolute calibration or practical equivalence claim without a separately justified fixed margin.
secondary_reporting: all comparator losses and costs by cell
terminal versus uninterrupted/recovery endpoints kept distinct
inference_cost_contract: target training labels and future branches
preprocessing and model fits including failed fits
all model evaluation calls and CPU
unresolved_before_freeze: full cost and storage qualification at admitted concurrency
